movie:1019939.overview: In the 19th century, a drunken applejack salesman must go from zero to hero and become North America's greatest fur trapper by defeating hundreds of beavers.

movie:10939.title: The Return of the Tall Blond Man with One Black Shoe

movie:130739.tagline: No job. No girl. No coffee.

movie:1437939.title: Cocorico 2

His voyage is one that transcends time and space, delving into the realms of history, medicine and love, all in search of true meaning to his life.

movie:160139.title: Night Train to Lisbon

movie:17339.title: Force 10 from Navarone

movie:192139.title: The Brink of War

movie:23439.tagline: Edgar Allan Poe's demonic tale of The Ungodly... The Evil House of Usher
movie:23439.title: House of Usher

movie:244539.title: Infinitely Polar Bear

movie:24739.tagline: There are 70 minutes to the end of the world. Where can you hide?
movie:24739.title: Miracle Mile

movie:26039.overview: After being double-crossed and left for dead, a mysterious man named Walker single-mindedly tries to retrieve the rather inconsequential sum of money that was stolen from him.

movie:26039.title: Point Blank

The film is a portrait of an artist at a crossroads and explores notions of courage and creative reinvention, as well as the ramifications of a life spent in the public eye.
movie:43939.title: I'm Still Here

movie:4539.title: Hearts of Darkness: A Filmmaker's Apocalypse

movie:6639.tagline: How long would you wait for love?
movie:6639.title: Love in the Time of Cholera

movie:726139.title: Project Silence
